reviews.text:
The staff are really nice and my dogs 🐶🐶 always really like going here.

The entrance is on the left side of the house at the top of the stairs, a door. A little hard to find. …
They have been flexible in accepting my puppy when I was on a business trip to Helsinki.

Absolutely the best daycare for pets in Helsinki. We have a 12.5 year old Milo who suffers from severe separation anxiety and has done really well there. Cage-free and always with a human. They go for a run and send videos to Whatsapp. It feels like the daycare really thinks about pets with their hearts, and not just about making money. We have tried several daycares and Herttoniemi Dog Hotel is number 1. Milo is going again on Saturday when we go on a cruise to Stockholm💖💖
Excellent dog daycare next to the metro, which I can recommend to everyone

Great dog daycare and hotel. The staff is knowledgeable and the dog loves the place and the caregivers. It has also helped the over-eager dog's character, he has gained patience and learned to work with other dogs. 😅 They quickly address any potential problems and openly talk about the dog's day. Reliable and caring. ❤️ …
Our dog has always had a great time. Dogs are accepted as individuals. Thank you very much every time!
